newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares on hold over U.S.Thanksgiving break.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares on hold over U.S.Thanksgiving break.

text.p: Danish share prices closed virtually unchanged on Thursday in a quiet market with dealers seeing the same picture persisting up to the weekend close.
"It was a rather dull day with a dearth of investors, the U.S. market fell yesterday and is closed today, putting a bit of a damper on things," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.11 point down at 130.08 while the KFX December future rose 0.20 point to 130.60 with 190 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Unidanmark rose three crowns to 292 after announcing a sales alliance with Sweden's PostGirot, putting the Danish bank's products in over 1,000 Swedish post office branches.

But the benefits of the deal appeared limited to at least one Danish analyst. "The question is if one can get the Swedes to buy Unibank products in Swedish post offices when they already have accounts in a Swedish bank," he said.
Bourse debutant InWear was the most traded share, rising two crowns to 265 crowns in turnover of 295,000 transactions. The stock has risen by 20 percent since its listing on Monday.
